meta.title: Personal concierge · Whatever you want, exactly how you want it · 1lev1
meta.description: Tell us in your own words what you need - a gift, a home repair, an event or a regular service. The concierge finds the professionals and builds one plan made entirely for you. Nothing moves without your approval.

hero.sub: Tell us in your own words what you need - a gift, a renovation, an event, a regular service. The concierge breaks the request down, finds the right professionals and comes back with one plan, made entirely for you.
hero.ctaNote: Start writing without signing up · the request itself is free

card.label: New request
card.text: A three-tier sea-themed birthday cake for my daughter, delivered to our door on Friday.

promise.p1d: No categories, no comparing, no chasing suppliers. Write what you want - that's it.
promise.p2t: Made for you, down to the detail
promise.p2d: Nothing off the shelf: every request is built around what you asked for - your timing, your place, your budget.
promise.p3d: You see the full offer and you approve it. Until then - no commitment.

how.title: How it works
how.s1d: Write it in your own words, like a message to a friend. Add when, where and what budget if you like.
how.s2t: We break it down and search
how.s2d: Lev, our smart assistant, splits the request into parts and finds who can provide each one.
how.s3d: Offers come to you. You can chat with any provider before deciding, and approve only what fits.
how.s4d: Once every part is approved the team gets to work - and you follow it all from one place.

consent.title: Nobody pressures you here.
consent.sub: Everything in the concierge happens by mutual agreement. No imposed price, no "take it or leave it", no fine print.
consent.c1d: No provider is assigned to your request without your approval.
consent.c2d: Instead of "no" and parting ways - a direct conversation with the provider until you reach something that works for you both.
consent.c3d: You see the full plan - who, what and when - before you commit to anything.
consent.c4d: Providers sign the same agreement: nobody forces anything on anyone.

ideas.title: What can you ask for?
ideas.sub: Almost anything. A few ideas to start:
ideas.gift: A gift no one else has
ideas.task: A repair or renovation at home
ideas.community: An event for friends or community
ideas.trip: A trip planned to the detail

faq.title: Quick questions
faq.q1: Do I need to sign up?
faq.a1: To start writing - no. When you want to send it: a short signature on the agreement, email and password, a confirmation email - and the request goes out by itself. No questionnaires, no profile.
faq.q2: What is the agreement I sign?
faq.a2: One mutual commitment: not to force or coerce. It protects you exactly as it protects whoever serves you.
faq.a3: The request itself is free. The price comes from the offers you receive - and you can state a budget up front so the offers fit it.
faq.a4: You choose while writing whether it is private or open to the community.
faq.q5: I started writing and didn't finish - what happens?
faq.a5: The request is saved as a draft, and you'll find it in the concierge and on your profile - exactly where you left it.

final.title: Got something in mind?
final.sub: Tell us. We'll build the rest together - by agreement.

reg.agreementOnly: One step and you're in: sign the agreement. No questionnaires, no profile - after confirming your email you go straight to your request.
reg.whyAgreement: The agreement is a mutual promise: nobody forces anything on anyone - you included.
